gloss: to appear; to emerge; to come into existence

definitions.gloss: to appear; to emerge; to come into existence
definitions.explanation: For something to come into view or into being, often something that was previously absent or unknown. Used for both physical appearances and the emergence of new phenomena.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{出現|しゅつげん}した。
{突然|とつぜん}、{目|め}の{前|まえ}に{大|おお}きな{影|かげ}が{出現|しゅつげん}した。
examples.english: Suddenly, a large shadow appeared before my eyes.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}によって、{新|あたら}しいビジネスモデルが{次々|つぎつぎ}と{出現|しゅつげん}している。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, new business models are emerging one after another.

notes:
A する verb composed of {出|しゅつ} (out) + {現|げん} (appear). Describes the appearance or emergence of something, often with a sense of significance or novelty. More formal than {現|あらわ}れる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新種|しんしゅ}が{出現|しゅつげん}する: a new species appears
- {問題|もんだい}が{出現|しゅつげん}する: a problem emerges
- {症状|しょうじょう}が{出現|しゅつげん}する: symptoms appear
- {出現|しゅつげん}{頻度|ひんど}: frequency of occurrence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現|あらわ}れる: to appear — more common in everyday speech
- {登場|とうじょう}する: to appear (on stage), to enter — for people or characters making an entrance
- {発生|はっせい}する: to occur, to arise — focuses on the onset of events or phenomena
